title: 60-Minute Beacon Hill Park Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This tour is wheelchair accessible. As long as you are able to get out of your wheelchair, the tour operator will look after it while you are on the tour
Not recommended for travelers with mobility issues
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Travel by horse-drawn carriage through many parts of Victoria, including Beacon Hill Park and the Dallas Road waterfront. Visit the Mile 0 of the Trans Canada Highway where you will experience the splendor of the Olympic Mountains and the Strait of Juan de Fuca. Tour routes are subject to change.
